plainTranslation: Their Venus in your 12th house can feel tender, secret, or hard to place. Love may live in the imagination before it becomes a clear agreement. Keep the affection honest and visible enough that it does not turn into longing for something unnamed.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
